# commit suggest

=== step 1: dashcrew "help" "commit"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Commit messages in the team's pattern (project.commit): a ready command, and a lint. Never commits.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew commit <subcommand> [arguments]
| -h, --help    Print this usage information.
| 
| Available subcommands:
|   lint      Check commit messages against project.commit; exit 1 with one line per problem.
|   suggest   Print the git add and git commit commands for the current changes, in the pattern.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 2: dashcrew "commit" "suggest" "--help"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Print the git add and git commit commands for the current changes, in the pattern.
| Type, scope and ticket come from the branch and the changed files; untracked files are listed, never added.
| Reads git only; with --subject the message is linted and a problem exits 1.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew commit suggest [arguments]
| -h, --help           Print this usage information.
| -p, --project        Any folder inside the repository.
|                      (defaults to ".")
|     --subject        The subject; without it the command keeps a <subject> placeholder.
|     --body           The body; without it and without --subject the command keeps a <body> placeholder.
|     --type           Override the type derived from the branch.
|     --scope          Override the scope derived from the files; an empty value drops it.
|     --ported-from    Comma-separated commits this change ports; each becomes a Ported-from: trailer.
|     --json           Print the derived parts and commands as JSON.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)
